import_atomicity.purpose: new rows, same-ID updates, idempotency, row errors and full invalid-batch rollback

voice_native_adk.purpose: required gemini-3.8-live with ADK Runner.run_live; PCM 16k input/24k output; no STT/TTS substitute

voice_classification_order.purpose: actual Laya precedes catalog for every semantic turn, including repeat and out-of-scope

voice_grounding.purpose: heard answer and visible card/map agree with current authoritative tool results; no filler timing

voice_interruption.purpose: barge-in clears playback, late events/stale epochs rejected, selection synchronized

voice_permissions.purpose: allow, deny, revoke, unsupported capture and explicit restart without auto-reconnect/replay

voice_failures.purpose: provider quota/outage, database failure, disconnect, setup timeout and session expiry

voice_bounds_privacy.purpose: 300s/60s/30s limits, cleanup, private callbacks, bounded audio/tools and no content logs

map_fallbacks.purpose: unmapped/disconnected shelves give truthful location; stale map reload/retry exactly once

map_accessibility.purpose: keyboard, screen reader, color-independent path; 320/360/768/1280px without overflow

auth_sessions.purpose: direct server auth, secure host cookie, rotation, eight-hour absolute expiry, logout/replay

auth_origin_csrf.purpose: trusted origin and session-bound CSRF on every protected write; denial before mutation

backoffice_integrity.purpose: publish/edit-draft/archive affect public reads and stale product IDs; FK rollback/concurrent 409

backoffice_persistence.purpose: more than 50 rows cursor correctly; restart/container/database persistence and revision

classifier_identity.purpose: convaiinnovations/laya pinned revision; weights/config/tokenizer hashes/license; CPU resources

classifier_safety.purpose: advisory only, confidence/margin frozen, abstention contracts, private access, no raw text logs

classifier_failures.purpose: malformed/down/slow/busy/missing-token; inclusive 1200ms deadline, 200ms queue, bounded worker, no retry

cold_and_faults.purpose: prospectively separate cold/setup/fault suites and resource observations, with failures retained

deployed_integration.purpose: one integrated candidate with real public APIs, native audio, actual Laya, restricted database and backoffice

release_review.purpose: feature-freeze decision and peer/high-risk human review recorded by accountable owners
